cues: In energy terms, for the same temperature rise d T: at constant volume the heat is C v d T, and all of it becomes d U.
At constant pressure the heat is C p d T, which is the same d U plus the extra work P d V.
text: In energy terms, for the same temperature rise d T: at constant volume the heat is C v d T, and all of it becomes d U. At constant pressure the heat is C p d T, which is the same d U plus the extra work P d V.
